shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — plus paintable glass skylight zones (stackable, grow-light sun), mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message on trip. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY (combat, drops) is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- **AMENDED 2026-07-24**: see-below VISION extends through skylight glass — surface can view basement through panes, sky can view two-deep through stacked panes. Vision + light only; zero gameplay crossing through glass (sealed: no shooting, rain, temperature, falling).
- All levels are real maps (pocket maps in Find.Maps, tick every game tick). Viewing a level swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + plateaus AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable) + AB_Skylight (Standable glass, dontRender).

## PERFORMANCE PASS (2026-07-24, quadruple pass) — complete, compile-green
Systematic four-theme audit of all 36k lines: (1) hot-path Harmony patches, (2) caching, (3) throttling/cadence, (4) allocation/GC. Verdict: architecture was already sound (TTL caches, version stamps, count-gated early-outs, elapsed-time `Due()` scheduling, hidden-map cadence stretch, async mask lane, material clone cache, per-tick probe budgets, versioned cooldowns with O(1) re-arm). Four zero-behavior-change fixes applied, all in Batch D code + one mirror hoist:
1. **SkylightSystem.CompFor** now CWT-cached (was an uncached `GetComponent` list scan riding per-frame `DrawBelowStatic`→`AnyPanes`, per-SetTerrain postfix, per-mesh-dirty mirror, per-shaft rare tick). Mirrors LevelExtensions.Levels() exactly.
2. **SkylightMapComp.AnyWork** memoized behind a `workVersion` stamp bumped in SetPlanned/RegisterPane/DropPane (was an O(panes+planned) hashset walk per construction pawn per work scan via WorkGiver_ABSkylights.ShouldSkip).
3. **Thing_ABSkylightShaft** caches its CompGlower (was `GetComp<CompGlower>()` linear scan per shaft per rare tick).
4. **LevelSync.OnLowerMeshDirty** flag mask (Things|Buildings|FogOfWar) hoisted to a lazily-built static (was 3 DefOf implicit conversions per MapMeshDirty event on every map; lazy with 0-sentinel because masks are assigned in PostSetIndices after def load).
Audited-and-cleared (no change needed): AreasAcrossLevels resolver (versioned TTL cache), ForbidUtility prefix-replace, RenderPatches (static-bool gates), LevelRenderer (frame-gated transform, async mask, padded rect), LevelComp tick (Due() stagger), NeedMigration (cheapest-first + type cache), CrossLevelWork (probe budget + versioned cooldowns), CrossLevelDemand (TTL + caps + reach memo), waterfall ticks (250t root re-check, count-gated sustainers), all per-frame combat visuals (count-gated first line), ABGuard.On (field read), ABMod.Settings (static field), ABLog.Dev calls (event/decision paths only), LINQ inventory (12 uses, all cold paths), IntVec3 hashsets (IEquatable, no boxing). Rejected as behavior-changing: zoom-gating the below thing-overlay pass (would drop below pawn name labels at far zoom).

## BATCH D (2026-07-24) — built, compile-green, UNTESTED
### Skylight zones (Systems/Skylights.cs, SkylightDesignators.cs, SkylightWork.cs)
- **UX**: two Designator_Cells in the vanilla Zone architect category (XML patch): "Skylight zone" / "Clear skylight zone". Painted on the level you are VIEWING; replaces the slab under your feet (surface floor -> glass over basement; sky rooftop -> glass over surface room). Hidden on maps with no level below + behind `skylights` setting (Work tab, default ON). Painted set = desired state; overlay via CellBoolDrawer on SkylightMapComp (ICellBoolGiver).
- **Work**: WorkGiver_ABSkylights (Construction) reconciles BOTH directions: planned-not-glass -> AB_BuildSkylight (2200 work), glass-not-planned -> AB_RemoveSkylight (1000 work). Work-only, no materials (user directive), no fail, Construction XP, Floor reservation layer. Original terrain recorded per pane and restored on removal.
- **State**: SkylightMapComp per map (panes/planned HashSets + originals Dict, scribed). GlobalPaneCount static lets hot paths early-out at zero panes. CompFor CWT-cached; AnyWork version-memoized (perf pass).
- **Light**: AB_SkylightShaft (invisible 1-cell Building, category Building/non-edifice) spawned on the LIT map under each pane. Stock CompGlower (radius 3.5, overlight 2.1 = TRUE full-sun plant growth near the pane, user directive) gated via IThingGlower: lit iff celestial sun >= 0.4 AND pane chain open (surface pane -> surface cell unroofed OR sky pane above). Rare-tick UpdateLit — vanilla lamp cadence; glower comp cached. KNOWN GAP: follows celestial sun; ignores weather/eclipse dimming; slightly generous at dusk.
- **Rendering** (LevelRenderer + SectionLayer_ABBelowThings): glass = dontRender terrain (same trick as AB_OpenAir) + renderer-drawn pale tint + dark frame hairlines in the mask/skirt pass. Below-band now draws for level 0 (surface->basement, gated on AnyPanes). Two-deep stack: sky view draws basement band at StackedDrop(420) deeper queues; surface's dontRender glass cells expose it exactly there; surface's own ABBelowThings submeshes (basement things at glass cells) drawn into the deep band; mask uses deepest-visible fog + stacked dim. ABBelowThings prints at air OR glass cells and runs on level-0 maps with panes; LevelSync mesh mirror extended to basement->surface. Dynamic pass: glass ignores lower roof (rooms under glass rooftops show live pawns); surface->basement live pawns work; KNOWN GAP: two-deep (sky->basement) shows printed content only, no live basement pawns from sky.
- **Safety nets**: TerrainGrid.SetTerrain postfix dissolves pane records when anything replaces glass (flooring, craters, rooftop sync). LevelSync.SyncCellFromBelow reverts glass rooftop -> AB_OpenAir when the roof below disappears (stairs-platform exempt). Load-time shaft validation (orphans despawn, missing spawn). BelowSelection.CellVisibleFromAbove treats glass as visible (overlays/forbid icons through panes).
### Mountain rivers + waterfalls (Levels/GenStep_ABSkyRivers.cs, Systems/Waterfalls.cs)
- **Basis**: vanilla 1.6 TileMutatorWorker_River only strips roof when river width > 20 — narrow rivers keep thick rock roof = tunnels under mountains, and sky plateaus sit exactly on that footprint.
- **Genstep AB_SkyRivers (order 205**, after SkyTerrain 200, before landmark mutators 220, `mountainRivers` setting default ON, Generation tab): for each ground-map river cell (BaseTerrainAt.IsRiver) under a sky mass cell (not air/rooftop/glass): destroy rock edifice, clear roof, unfog, copy the EXACT surface water terrain def. Parity is by construction (plumb projection of the tile's actual generation). Flow: clone riverGraph nodes + straight-copy riverFlowMap (same map size); WaterInfo.SetTextures rebuilds the flow texture from those — pixel-exact vanilla flow, no reflection.
- **Waterfalls**: lip cells = carved river cells bordering AB_OpenAir; direction from ground waterInfo.GetWaterMovement dot the edge normal (>0.35 downstream = full waterfall; <-0.35 upstream = foam-only quiet "source" lip). Thing_ABWaterfall: two-frame foam band + falling-sheet quad (Things/AB_WaterfallFoamA/B via MaterialPool, declared in cs-assets.json), WaterSplash flecks, sustainer AB_WaterfallLoop (vanilla rain clip Ambience/Amb_Raining2_Loop pitched 0.70-0.78, spatial distRange 9-46 — stock Ambient_Rain is onCamera and can't attenuate). Cluster etiquette: only the root lip (no same-def west/south neighbor) plays; root recheck throttled to 250t. Thing_ABWaterfallBase spawned on the surface river below downstream drops (thinned to 1 per 4 cells): mist + rumble at ground level. Fails soft: any genstep exception logs and skips rivers.
- KNOWN GAPS: applies only to sky levels generated after the feature exists (no retrofit); wide (>20) rivers are open canyons and correctly no-op; landmark mutators could theoretically overlap the channel (structure placement avoids water natively).

## PARITY BATCH A (2026-07-24) — USER-VERIFIED
- **FORMATION GOTO (vanilla-exact)**: ABBelowGotoDrag = full MultiPawnGotoController mirror. All selection mixes; cross pawns previewed from their stair exit, routed + replayed on release.
- **ONE-STEP REINSTALL** (Logistics/ReinstallAcrossLevels.cs): cross-level reinstall = auto Uninstall designation, detector migrates, mini ferried, vanilla installs.
- **STAIR FORBID — door parity**: CompForbiddable on stairs/ladders/elevators, mirrors IsForbiddenToPass exactly, either end seals the passage.

## PARITY BATCH B (2026-07-24) — built, verification pending
- **NATURAL MEDITATION FOCI**: vanilla FindMeditationSpot probed on linked levels (virtual swap); travel on strictly stronger focus (+0.05 hysteresis).
- **PENS ACROSS LEVELS**: auto rehome ONLY when no local pen accepts; DOUBLE virtual swap probe; ABPendingOrders replay.
- **CELL-TARGETED CASTS** (TryHandleGenericCell): route-then-cast through open air.
- **RITUAL PRISONERS + ANIMALS**: secure prisoners + colony animals join gathers cross-level.

## PARITY BATCH C (2026-07-24) — built, verification pending (companion mods)
- **ROOFTOP AIRSHIP LANDINGS** (ABAirshipsCompat), **SKY VISITOR ARRIVALS** (50% divert, setting ON), **HOSPITALITY GUEST ROAMING** (lord retention + idle tourism, setting ON), **STRANDED-NEUTRAL SWEEP** (600t).

## FOOD OPTIMALITY ACROSS LEVELS (2026-07-24)
Patch_GetFood_CrossLevel: sub-meal local picks contest linked levels' best via vanilla FoodOptimality with REAL travel cost; reroute on win (+1 hysteresis). Starving always eat local. KNOWN GAP: single-hop probe.

## LOGISTICS — unchanged (island rework + RELAY + URGENT; forbid-gated islands; export pin split; urgent fetch leg). KNOWN GAPS unchanged.
## AREAS / ZONES — unchanged. Stairs deliberately NOT area-gated. Skylight zones live OUTSIDE the area system (own comp grid — no AreaManager save entanglement).
## CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT (Model B) — unchanged (BUG1 neutral retest pending; CE direct fire verified). Glass is NOT a firing line — sealed.
## SETTINGS — seven tabs + skyVisitorArrivals, hospitalityRoaming, **skylights (Work), mountainRivers (Generation)**.

## Test plan (current)
- Batch B verify (isolated): anima meditation pull, cross-level take-to-pen, cell-cast below, ritual prisoner/animal gather, berries-vs-fridge food upgrade.
- **Batch D verify (isolated, river mountain tile)**: paint skylight on surface floor -> builder installs -> basement visible + lit + plants grow under overlight; paint sky rooftop glass -> room below visible incl. pawns; stack both -> basement from sky (printed content); clear zone -> restoration; floor-over-glass + roof-removal dissolve paths; sky level on a river-under-mountain tile -> plateau watercourse, waterfall foam/spray/sound at ledges, base mist on surface; flow direction matches surface.
- Batch C verify (companionMods: Orion.Hospitality, joeownage.automatic.airships).
- Older stack: relay/urgent with Allow Tool, BUG1 neutral CE retest, CE-absent palette run, translation audit, soak, publishing.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE. Biomes! Caverns. Alpha Biomes. BM + MO. Odyssey + VLE. Misc. Robots + Robots++. Hauler's Dream + PUAH. Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. CE. Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF. Medieval Trader Airships (+legacy), Hospitality (Continued). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (7th pass): Batches A+forbid verified; B + C built; food fix built; Batch D built compile-green; **quadruple performance pass complete (4 cache/hoist fixes, all zero-behavior-change, build green)**. Next: Batch B+D test (isolated), then Batch C with companion mods.
